findings.summary: A changed eligible-candidate set does not refresh picker results or invalidate a removed selection.
findings.reproduction: Open Matter add dialog, select Alex from candidates=[Alex], rerender same Matter with new If-Match and candidates=[] (router.refresh shape). Alex remains checked in FormData.
findings.cause: latestSearch ref changes without rerunning effect; chosen is always prepended even if candidate set no longer contains it.
findings.fix: Reconcile the actual complete eligible-candidate set with selection and displayed options. Keep role/UNKNOWN/command state; do not blindly remount IntentForm or treat filtered search absence as ineligibility.

findings.summary: Previous query results stay selectable while the new query is pending.
findings.reproduction: Initial response contains Alex. Type Bao and hold its response unresolved. Alex is still enabled/clickable although status says Searching.
findings.fix: Hide or disable unselected stale results until current query settles; retain a previously chosen item in a clearly distinct selected area.
